title: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.40492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. translated_title: 智能体大学：面向个性化学习的协作智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型支持个性化辅导、内容生成和自适应学习路径。然而，能力发展需要将这些资源和互动组织成一个能够随学习者共同演进的连贯学习过程。一个核心挑战在于对齐目标、活动和评估，同时利用学习证据来决定后续应采取的步骤。我们提出了人类参与式多智能体组织，并将其具体化为智能体大学。在AU中，学习者作为组织成员参与其中，与专业化智能体协作，共同维护一个可修订的能力计划。该计划将个人目标、跨模态的学习活动和分层评估联系起来，同时学习者的反馈和表现指导后续的支持。我们的评估表明，该系统在计划组织、评估设计和修订质量方面具有优势。用户取得了更大的平均评估提升（在50分制的评估中为12.19分对比5.61分）。
tldr: 提出了人类参与式多智能体组织框架“智能体大学”（AU），让学习者作为组织成员与专业化智能体协作，共同维护可修订的能力计划，实现对个人目标、学习活动和分层评估的动态对齐，从而支持个性化学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization instantiated as Agentic University (AU), where learners act as organization members collaborating with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program that aligns personal goals, cross-modal learning activities, and layered assessment for personalized learning.
